name: Tower placement & wave spawner
oneLiner: A tower-defense core: foes march along a fixed road through a grid (one or more paths from waypoint cells); towers go on the grass cells beside it, never on it, so the road can never be blocked. Pick a tower, see its range ring and a red warning on cells where it cannot stand, build, upgrade (three levels), sell (70% back), and give each tower a target priority (first, strong, near). Four built-in towers (single shot, splash, slow, chain), waves as plain data with the next wave previewed, gold, lives, speed x1 / x2, pause, win and lose. Seeded and frame-stepped, with a bot that builds and upgrades through the player's own input path.
fits: tower defense and lane defense games
base or castle defense stages inside a strategy or adventure game
survival levels where the player prepares a route before waves arrive
puzzle-like defense maps with fixed build spots and a road
notFor: maze-building defense where towers reroute the foes (the road here is fixed by design)

needs: a map: grid rows (grass, trees, rocks, water) and the road as waypoint cells per path
waves as data (groups of enemy ids with count, gap, delay, path), tower and enemy tables (built-ins ship)
a seed per field and a fixed 60 Hz update step
key or pointer input routed to the field while it runs
a place to go when the field is won or lost
provides: the rules: road cells and blocked cells, build / upgrade / sell with gold, three-level towers, targeting priorities, projectiles, splash, slow, chain lightning, armour, wave spawner with countdown and early-call bonus, lives, win / lose

the screen: painted grass field with road, props, burrow and gate, towers whose turrets turn to their target, top-view foes that turn with the road, range ring and placement ghost, red blocked-cell warning, HUD (lives, gold, wave bar, speed, pause), build panel, tower panel (upgrade, sell, target), next-wave preview, banners

a bot that picks cells by road coverage, builds, upgrades, sets priorities and calls waves through the input path
unit anchors (live, enemies and towers), unit rects, UI rects, field rect, actors() text state

assets: module/tower-defense.js (global GameDNA_TowerDefense, no dependencies; API in module/README.md). Everything is drawn in code: the grass field, road, trees, rocks, ponds, the burrow and the gate, four towers with three levels each, six top-view foes (mite, crawler, skitterling, moth, shellback, the Brood Matron boss) with walking legs or flapping wings, projectiles, explosions, frost, lightning, HUD and panels. No external files.
